hole_reason: a journal not given, a record pruned by retention or crypto-shredded, or a decision the sink dropped (the 1 trace(s) given report 0 dropped record(s); a trace without decisions.stats.json beside it reports none, which is not zero)
order: event time where a record has one, file order where it has none. The journal is authoritative; the trace is best-effort (its sink drops and counts). A KV receipt is not journaled and joins only by operation id.
